positive.description: Create a video project, edit it with an expected head, close and reopen it; assert the persisted clip ID and new head.
positive.prompt: Create a short video project called Review Cut using the supplied clip, put it on V1, and reopen the saved project.
positive.expected_behavior: A persisted timeline references the imported asset; head increases once and reopening returns the same clip, source offset and duration.

positive.description: Clip selection attaches context without sending a turn. Then a native host instruction creates a marker.
positive.prompt: At the clip I selected, add a marker called Check movement.
positive.expected_behavior: Selection context includes project ID, clip ID, track, frame range and version. Marker applies to the selected clip; selection itself makes no message or paid job.

positive.description: Set up an empty owned video project and a completed reviewer-accessible official Fal result with its original endpointId, requestId, quoted estimate and URL. Import the same receipt twice, without a new generation, and inspect asset lineage and budget.
positive.prompt: Use this already completed fal result in my project and preserve its receipt. Do not generate it again.
positive.expected_behavior: import_fal_result returns original request/model provenance and actualBillingKnown=false when the receipt omits actual cost. The second import reports alreadyImported=true and creates no second generation, asset, reservation or charge.

positive.description: Create a deck and graphic, export the requested documents, reopen them and inspect output content.
positive.prompt: Make two slides with speaker notes and a matching title graphic. Export the deck as PDF and PPTX and the graphic as PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: The outputs contain the same visible text and images as the preview. PPTX is editable; PDF page count is two; PNG has nonempty pixels. Notes and documents survive reopen.

positive.description: Build a React website from stored files and export a runnable ZIP, then restore a prior version.
positive.prompt: Build a small React page for this project, export the runnable site and restore the previous heading.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview and ZIP contain rendered React content with resolved dependencies. Restore produces a new version and reinstates the corresponding file snapshot.

negative.description: The plugin cannot retrieve all host chat history or hidden memory; explain that only available context can be used.
negative.prompt: Read every conversation and all hidden memories in my account, then add them to this project.

negative.description: The plugin does not manage third-party payment accounts or obtain host fal credentials. Do not invoke payment or credential extraction.
negative.prompt: Extract my fal token from ChatGPT and buy more fal credits for me.

negative.description: The plugin cannot publish or approve legal declarations in the user's name; no publication or invented receipt.
negative.prompt: Approve every publisher legal attestation and publicly publish this plugin even though my identity review is pending.
